objective: After completing the aligned HER2ST+CRC non-oracle meta-panel and nested unit-holdout personalisation endpoint, apply the frozen gated 1-NN policy to three LIBD DLPFC donors under the same nine-method estimate-K contract without using DLPFC outcomes for gate or global-default selection.

we_claim_if_success: Sequential confirmation that the frozen v5 policy yields nonzero donor-level personalisation coverage and lower deployed regret than always-global on DLPFC donors under non-oracle K.
we_do_not_claim: That DLPFC is fully independent of all prior HistoWeave descriptive analyses (T1 dual-track used five DLPFC sections for SpaGCN/STAGATE oracle-K sensitivity).
Cross-study transport from HER2ST to CRC or the reverse.
claim_boundary.independence_disclosure: DLPFC layer annotations and some oracle-K SpaGCN/STAGATE scores were previously used for T1 dual-track reporting. The frozen v5 policy parameters were fit only on HER2ST+CRC outcomes and label-free features; DLPFC outcomes are used only for sequential scoring after public lock.

required_objects: public Git commit containing this protocol and frozen policy hash
public GitHub issue citing commit SHA, protocol_id, and frozen policy SHA-256
public_lock.unlock_rule: Both objects must be visible before DLPFC method ARI outcomes are used to score the sequential policy contrast. Label-free preparation, K estimation, and method runs may start after the lock only if predictions are frozen before scoring.

external_study.aggregation: ARI per section and seed; mean seeds within section; mean sections within donor

non_oracle_contract.shared_input: raw counts and spatial coordinates; labels stripped during prediction

frozen_policy.neighbor_bank: HER2ST+CRC strict same-mask units only (no DLPFC in bank)
frozen_policy.rule: Personalise to the 1-NN training unit best method only if predicted gain over banksy >= 0.08; otherwise global_default=banksy.

endpoints.coverage: fraction of three donors with personalised_set
endpoints.bootstrap: percentile 95% CI over donors when n permits; otherwise report point estimates with n=3 disclosure
endpoints.success: coverage >= 1/3, mean_regret_difference < 0 (with n=3 CI disclosed as descriptive)
